cd /workspace/project && cat > OPENHANDS_NOMASK.md <<'EOF'
# Pasang nomask di OpenHands (Cloud)
Masalah utama: **`force_string_serializer` tidak ada kolomnya di GUI**, dan `max_tokens`
kecil bikin `content` kosong. Ikuti urutan ini.
## 1. Buka Settings LLM
`app.all-hands.dev` -> **Settings** -> **LLM** -> **Add / Advanced**
## 2. Isi field
| Field | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Provider | **Custom** (atau OpenAI-compatible) |
| Model | `deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored` |
| Base URL | `https://api.nomask.ai/v1` |
| API Key | `nmk_live_...` (dari `nomask_live_keys.txt`) |
| **Max Output Tokens** | **8000**  <- JANGAN 100/512 |
| Temperature | 0.7 |
## 3. Field custom / litellm_extra_body
Kalau GUI punya kotak "extra body" / "custom model kwargs", isi:
```json
{"force_string_serializer": true}
```
Kalau TIDAK ada kotak itu -> flag hilang saat save. Itu sebab error
`content must be a string`.
## 4. Simpan, lalu tes
Kirim: `jalankan: echo halo`
- Harus muncul tool call `bash` -> berarti jalan.
## Kalau masih gagal
| Gejala | Sebab | Obat |
|---|---|---|
| `content must be a string` | flag hilang | pakai model non-reasoning / set extra body |
| Agen diam, balasan kosong | `max_tokens` kecil | naikkan ke 8000 |
| HTTP 402 `insufficient_balance` | saldo habis | ganti key |
| Timeout | model lambat | pakai `glm-5.3_flash_uncensored` |
## Model pengganti kalau deepseek rewel
Non-reasoning (paling aman untuk OpenHands):
```
glm-5.3_flash_uncensored
qwen_3.8_uncensored
mimo-v2.6-flash-uncensored
```
## Fakta terukur (17 Nov)
- `max_tokens=10` -> content kosong; `30+` -> terisi
- tool calling OK: `finish_reason=tool_calls`, args valid
- `max_tokens=512/2000/8000` -> semua berhasil panggil `bash`
EOF


echo dibuat; git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Add OpenHands+nomask setup guide" && echo committed
dibuat
committed
